mistake_reason: At step 11, Orchestrator broadened the constraint from a 10-minute walk to a generic 10-minute travel window across transit or bike modes, shifting the task away from the user's explicit walking-time requirement. This scope creep (FM-2.3 Task Derailment) led the team to evaluate and present pairs that are reachable in ≤10 minutes by bus or bike, mislabeling or implying them as walkable. As a result, the final answer lists Paintball Fun Cologne GmbH and Art Wave Actionpainting—neither of which is actually within a 10-minute walk of a karting track—while excluding the correct walking-distance match (Adrenalinpark Köln ↔ Le Mans Karting).
